Hollow Knight: Silksong – Negating Poison with the Wreath of Purity
In Act 2 you’ll face Muckmaggot water that inflicts a nasty poison, but you can cure it forever with the Wreath of Purity. This nifty charm nullifies the poison status, leaving you free to explore without fear of slow damage ticking away.
